items.html: And there are Gevurot in the Achoraim of the male, and there are also Gevurot in the mochin, and both are sawed off and given to her. (It appears from this that the inner aspects are the mochin, in which there are also aspects of Gevurot of BaN given to her, and likewise in the vessels from without. And he remains in MaH. And see in another place well the matter of the Gevurot and the embrace with the right and the left, and the coupling, and how many kinds of Hasadim and how many kinds of Gevurot there are — from the Ari, of blessed memory.)
